description: MongoDB is a source-available cross-platform document-oriented database program.
misconfigurations: no authentication enabled (default in older versions)
real_world_incidents: Tens of thousands of exposed MongoDB databases wiped and held for ransom by automated scripts.

audience_guidance.student: Older versions of MongoDB didn't require a password by default. Hackers love finding these to steal data and demand ransom.
audience_guidance.developer: Always start mongod with --auth. Edit mongod.conf to bind_ip 127.0.0.1 or your private VPC IP.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Attempt to connect without credentials. If successful, you have full access to dump the database.
audience_guidance.pentester: Connect via mongo shell. Check for sensitive data. Do NOT modify data during testing.
audience_guidance.security_team: Scan internal network for unauthenticated MongoDB instances. Ensure security groups block 27017 externally.
